paite: Himahleh tunung chiang in mi khenkhatte'n; pimangna khate leh dawite thuhilhna limsak in, ginna atawpsan ding uh chih Kha in kichiantak in agen hi; huai tuh,
heading: Sinsakmi Takloute
english: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,

paite: mizuautheite lepchiahna ziak in ahi; huai mizuautheite amau sia-le-pha theihna ngei a sik am a halkeu bang ahi uhi.
english: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,

paite: Kiten akham ua, nek ding ante, thutak thei a gingtate'n kipahthu gen a san ding a Pathian in asiamte, nek louh ding achi uhi.
english: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

paite: Pathian thilsiam chiteng ahoih ngal a, kipahthu gen a san ahih khit nak photleh bangmah deih louh ding ahi kei hi;
english: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.

paite: Pathian thu leh thumna a hihsiangthou ahi khinta hi.
english: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

paite: Huaite unaute na sinsakleh Khrist Jesu nasempa hoihtak, ginna leh thuhilhna hoih tutan a na zuih thu a vaklian na hi ding hi.
heading: Khrist Jesu Nasempa Hoih
english: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

paite: Himahleh Pathian zahlouhna leh tangthu bulbal neiloute deih ke'n. Pathian limsak ding in kithuzoh in;
english: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

paite: pumpi kisawizoina aphatuam zek a; Pathian limsakna pen tangtawn in, tua omsa hinna leh hong om nawn ding piak chiamna aneih ziak in thil tengteng ah aphatuam hi.
english: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

paite: Hiai thu amuanhuai in alak tuak mahmah hi.
english: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.

paite: Huchi in Pathian hing i muan ziak in i semgim ua, i pang teitei uhi; amah mi tengteng Hondampa ahi a, agingtate Hondampa ahi tuanse hi.
english: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

paite: Hiaite thupiak in pia inla, sinsak in.
heading: Timothi Hinkhua Leh Asinsakna

paite: Na naupanna kuamah musitsak ke'n; thugen ah, tatdan ah, itna ah, kha ah, ginna leh sianthouna ah, gingtute zuih ding hi zaw in.
english: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

paite: Ka hong pai masiah laisim, hanthawn leh thugin limsak in.
english: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

paite: Nangmah a om thilpiak thugenkholhna a piak, upate khut ngak a Pathian in nang ahon neihsak limsak lou ke'n.
english: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

paite: Mi tengteng kiang a na phattuamna alattheihna ding in huai thilte ah thanuam inla, kizang zou in.
english: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

paite: Nangmah leh na thuhilh ah pilvang in; huai thilte hih in om gige in; huchibang hih in nangmah leh na thuzate na hondam ding hi.
english: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
